description: A theme as its host has it (its themes folder's <name>/: theme.css and tokens.json), worked out by the host for every app alike: the desktop apps draw its CSS over theirs and its colours, the phone its colours.

css.description: Its theme.css (GTK CSS, the desktop apps': drawn over all of theirs), empty if it has none.

light.description: Each colour of schema/tokens' libadwaita and baude groups the theme makes other than Baude's own in light, by its token's path: #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa where it's see-through. A colour made of another (baude.rule of libadwaita.borders) is here when that one's set.

dark.description: Each colour of schema/tokens' libadwaita and baude groups the theme makes other than Baude's own in dark, by its token's path: #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa where it's see-through. A colour made of another (baude.rule of libadwaita.borders) is here when that one's set.

error.description: Why its files can't be used, in place of the rest.
